name: sibo-research-db
description: Search 7M+ comments from 18 health subreddits (SIBO, MCAS, IBS, long covid, mold, more) with Claude.
long_description:
A patient-research database covering ~7.2M comments and ~695k posts from 18 health-focused subreddits.

Search across SIBO, MCAS, IBS, dysautonomia, long COVID, microbiome, histamine intolerance, mold illness, candida, and more. Find treatment patterns, dose ranges, side effects, and recovery stories across thousands of real reported cases.

This is patient-reported data, not clinical data. Use it to surface patterns and leads worth bringing to a doctor or clinical literature — not as a substitute for either. Do not contact users found in the data.

Requires the reddit.db database file (~5.4 GB), available at huggingface.co/datasets/toczix/sibo-research-db.

db_path.title: Database file (reddit.db)
db_path.description: Path to the reddit.db file you downloaded from huggingface.co/datasets/toczix/sibo-research-db. The file is ~5.4 GB.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Database statistics: total counts, subreddit breakdown, date range.

tools.name: list_subreddits
tools.description: List every subreddit in the dataset with post and comment counts.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search posts and comments. Supports AND/OR/NOT/NEAR()/phrases, date filtering, subreddit filtering, score filtering.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get a full Reddit thread (post + top comments) by post ID.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single post without its comments.

tools.name: get_top_posts
tools.description: Get the highest-scored posts, optionally filtered by subreddit.

tools.name: count_mentions
tools.description: Count how many posts and comments mention a term across the dataset, with subreddit breakdown.

tools.name: compare_mentions
tools.description: Compare how widely several terms are discussed, side by side.

tools.name: find_active_voices
tools.description: Find users with the most reported experience on a topic. Output is for tracing one person's perspective — not for contacting them.

tools.name: sql_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the database. Streams results and caps at 200 rows.
